name: Shocker
author: aliexitron
description: Excessive use of power have caused heavy damage to the MOTHER WIRE , the planets main power source . You have been turned into Shocker , a hero made of pure electricity, and sent into the MOTHER WIRE to restore the FLOW . Careful thinking is required to reconnect weak points and move on to the next areas . There is also loop holes and detours to make things more interesting and challenging . The game features 15 levels plus a very easy to use level editor. Simple controls ( just the arrow keys ) and overall presentation .
